notes: B1 now teaches as much as A2 does. Every lesson from 174 to 344 has been topped up with real example sentences on its own topic, 555 of them, so the hardest half of the course no longer carries the thinnest lessons. Vocabulary packs are also held back until the lesson that teaches them, so a themed block of words never arrives as flashcards long before anything explains it. The Review tab lists the packs you have actually started, newest first.
